interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to scan for ip.access BTS devices. abisip-find takes no config file; this list is used to generate the invocation arguments (e.g., running `abisip-find eth0` for each interface). If empty, the tool may be invoked without arguments to auto-detect, depending on the wrapper/service logic. Items must be non-empty strings matching actual interface names. Per abisip-find(1), root privileges (sudo) are required to scan.
